_help: Look-and-feel only. simple = warm colors, greeting banner, and still leaf accents. animated = a few leaves falling across the top. loading = leaves drifting around the splash logo. Each value is independent: auto follows start/end (inclusive, US Central calendar dates), true forces that piece on, false forces it off. A visit can preview without editing this file: ?theme=thanksgiving-simple, ?theme=thanksgiving-animated, ?theme=thanksgiving-loading, ?theme=thanksgiving (all three), or ?theme=off. Add &splash=preview to hold the loading screen until it is tapped.
